answer: One concrete mechanism: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because voyage only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, shale is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any signal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
